thread:
Devon (Procurement): Heads up — QuotaSage renewal landed. They sent a quote and a spreadsheet. Key parts look like Tiered token pricing + ingest GB. Can folks eyeball before I sign the pilot?

Ari (Finance): Can you drop the spreadsheet or at least the quick totals?

Devon (Procurement): Uploaded excerpt: `Pricing: $0.0009/token up to 100M, $0.0007/token >100M; Ingest: $125/GB for first TB then $90/GB.` They also list `anchoring_credit = min(0.2 * commit, 50000)` in the notes. PDF: https://qsage.example.com/quote/RED-12345.pdf

Maya (Eng-ML): :eyes: That anchoring_credit formula seems odd. Does it stack with our committed credit? Also they say 'quantization required' to hit tier2 — need details.

Raj (Legal): We need to see SLA, audit right, and termination language. Also meter/reporting cadence.

billing-bot: Estimate created: Invoice #QS-234 for $18,600 (estimate). Link: https://billing.redwood/estimates/QS-234

Devon (Procurement): Quick asks I want to send vendor: 1) explicit definition of "token" (are embeddings counted separately?), 2) cap on monthly overage in $ (not %), 3) monthly CSV usage export, 4) clarity on anchoring_credit behavior for pilots.

Ari (Finance): From a finance perspective: prefer a flat committed discount rather than many micro tiers. Anchoring credit capped at 50k seems large relative to a short pilot. If pilot is ~25k/mo, that anchor is effectively 2 months credit — ask for proportional anchor or shorter vesting.

Maya (Eng-ML): Also check whether inference egress / network is included. For our on-prem cache plan we need KV-cache traffic excluded from ingest billing.

Raj (Legal): I'll propose: monthly usage report, monthly CSV, 60-day invoice dispute window, no retroactive clawbacks without 30-day notice. Also will ask for data residency language for pilot.

Devon (Procurement): Vendor note: "anchoring_credit recalc if usage < 70% of commit in month 2" — that's a red flag. Should ask for no retroactive recalc for pilot months, only prospective adjustments.

Ari (Finance): Agreed. Ask them to remove retroactive recalculation. If they insist, cap the recalc to at most 20% of the anchor and require clear formula.

Maya (Eng-ML): :thumbsup: I'm OK with pilot if they confirm quantization is optional or they provide a hosted fallback with same latency SLO. Also need model artifact export rules spelled out.

Devon (Procurement): I'll draft counter-email tomorrow AM. Proposed bullets: clarify token definition, exclude KV cache from ingest, no retro recalc for pilot, monthly CSV, cap overage in dollars, 30-day eval credit separate from anchor. Anyone want to add phrasing or be on the thread?

Raj (Legal): Add: termination for convenience after pilot with pro-rata refund of unused commit credits.

Ari (Finance): Add request: provide an example month-by-month billing calc for three usage patterns (50%, 100%, 150% of commit) so we can model worst-case.

Devon (Procurement): Great. I'll include those and loop in procurement-pool. Thanks all. /cc @procurement-pool

Maya (Eng-ML): I'll stand by to review the quantization clause when you get their reply.

Devon (Procurement): Sending draft in #vendors-drafts later today for edits.
